name: Visma
verdict: Visma is majority-owned by Hg Capital & co-investors (70.5%); GIC, Singapore's sovereign wealth fund, owns 14.2%.
note: Norwegian business-software company headquartered in Oslo, title sponsor of Team Visma | Lease a Bike since 2019. Rating note: on hold for a maintainer. Proposed Concern: GIC, Singapore's sovereign wealth fund, holds 14.2% of Visma (over the 5% threshold, without control), and Singapore's record of drug-offence executions is recorded (singapore-drug-executions-2025). Majority owner Hg Capital (70.5%) is a private equity firm with no known record. Smaller state-linked stakes below 5%: Folketrygdfondet (manages the Government Pension Fund Norway) 0.9% and CPP Investments (Canada) 1.9% — too small to count. Visma's shareholder page also lists two GIC staff on its board (Henry Ormond, Marie Gomez), a second, independent path to the same Concern.

why.text: Singapore, whose state investor GIC owns 14.2% of the team's title sponsor Visma, carried out 17 executions in 2025, 15 of them for drug-related offences — a use of the death penalty UN human-rights experts urged the country to end in August 2026.
why.messageLine: Ask Team Visma | Lease a Bike whether a sponsor 14.2%-owned by Singapore's state fund fits a team that markets itself on fair play.
